sloka: तथागतां समुत्पत्य सपत्न्यस्ता भृशातुराः ।पर्यवस्थापयामासू रुदन्त्यो रुदतीं भृशम् ।। ६.११४.८९ ।।
transliteration: tathāgatāṁ samutpatya sapatnyastā bhṛśāturāḥ ।paryavasthāpayāmāsū rudantyo rudatīṁ bhṛśam ।। 6.114.89 ।।

translations.english: In a state of unconsciousness, when Mandodari, fell on Ravana's chest, shrunk in agony, she was like a flash of lightning glowing in a rainy cloud reddened by the blow of twilight.
